verdicts.file: Painting; 'L'inhumation precipitee', by A. J. Wiertz Wellcome L0010253.jpg
verdicts.note: Monochrome 19th-c. print: a corpse's arm hanging out of a wooden coffin in a grave pit, coffin lids around; a cholera burial, no ruins.

verdicts.file: Hallopora multitabulata fossil bryozoan (Ordovician; Frankfort, Illinois, USA).jpg
verdicts.note: Grey knobbly fossil on a museum mount with a scale bar; a North American bryozoan specimen, no architecture.

verdicts.file: Fistulipora neglecta fossil bryozoan (Silurian; near Waldron, Indiana, USA) (15209549272).jpg
verdicts.note: Porous tan-grey fossil rock slab photographed on a plain blue background; nothing of a burial complex.

verdicts.file: Bryozoan (reconstructed colony) (Cincinnatian Series, Upper Ordovician; vicinity of Cincinnati, Ohio, USA) 4.jpg
verdicts.note: White branching fossil colony laid on black museum felt beside printed labels; US fossil specimen.

verdicts.file: Bryozoan (reconstructed colony) (Cincinnatian Series, Upper Ordovician; vicinity of Cincinnati, Ohio, USA) 5.jpg
verdicts.note: Grey branching bryozoan colony on black felt with labels ('Young, Complete Bryozoan Colonies'); a museum fossil.

verdicts.file: Semicoscinium tenuiceps (fossil bryozoan) (Lockport Dolomite, Middle Silurian; Rockford Stone Company Quarry, Rockford, Ohio, USA).jpg
verdicts.note: Sparkling grey fossil mass with a lace-like pattern on a dark shelf; a US rock specimen.

verdicts.file: Trepostome bryozoan (Kope Formation, Upper Ordovician; Rt. 9 roadcut near Alexandria, Kentucky, USA) 2.jpg
verdicts.note: Grey branching fossil slab lying on plain grey background with a hard shadow; no site features.

verdicts.file: Trepostome bryozoan (Kope Formation, Upper Ordovician; Rt. 9 roadcut near Alexandria, Kentucky, USA) 1.jpg
verdicts.note: Same grey fossil branch on a light grey backdrop, seen flat; a specimen, not a landscape.

verdicts.file: Bryozoan (Corryville Member, McMillan Formation, Upper Ordovician; Flemingsburg South roadcut, Fleming County, Kentucky, USA) 4.jpg
verdicts.note: Polished pink-grey fossil cross-section held between fingers above grey gravel; a hand specimen.

verdicts.file: Bryozoan (Corryville Member, McMillan Formation, Upper Ordovician; Flemingsburg South roadcut, Fleming County, Kentucky, USA) 2.jpg
verdicts.note: Dark rounded fossil lump with fine radiating lines among broken shale chips in a quarry.
